about.title: A digital solution that makes buying and selling property simpler.
about.body: UProperty Market makes the process simpler and more direct: you talk securely, over chat, with no need for middlemen, no personal contacts shared and no commission on the sale.
about.imageLabel: Smiling woman at her laptop, buying or selling a home online with no middlemen

fairMarket.title: A fairer market
fairMarket.body: We stand for a fairer, more accessible market, where every family can find a home, with no speculation or inequality and real opportunities for everyone.

freedom.title: Freedom to negotiate
freedom.body: We believe in direct, free negotiation, with no middlemen or outside pressure: an open conversation between buyer and seller, for better deals.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.body: We leave out the property market’s unnecessary practices. Trust comes from clarity, with simple, secure communication between everyone involved.

business.title: An integrated management solution for the construction sector.
business.body: At UProperty Market you get an integrated system with tools built specifically for what the construction sector needs. Centralise all your company's information in one place, always available and always up to date.
business.imageLabel: Site engineer in a hard hat and high-visibility vest checking plans on a construction site

faq.title: Clear up your questions before you decide
faq.body: Every request sent through the form is answered in the order it arrives. If you prefer, email us at info@upropertymarket.pt

availability.q: When will the platform be available?
availability.a: The platform is in pre-launch. Pre-registering now secures you early access and the launch prices.

cost.q: How much does the platform cost?
cost.a: Every plan is paid and none of them charges commission on the sale. You will find each plan's price in the Pricing section, yearly or monthly.

professional.q: Do I need to work in the industry to use it?
professional.a: No. UProperty Market was designed to connect owners and buyers directly, with no middlemen.

mobile.q: Can I use UProperty Market on my phone only?
mobile.a: Yes. The platform is fully responsive, and a dedicated mobile app will follow.

contactVisible.q: Will my phone number show on the listing?
contactVisible.a: Never. All communication happens through the platform's chat until you choose to share more.

bug.q: What if I find a problem on the platform?
bug.a: Every dashboard has a “Report a problem” button. Describe what happened, attach a screenshot, and the IT team keeps you posted on the status.

confirmEmail.title: Confirm your email address
confirmEmail.body:
Hello {name},

We have received your early-access sign-up for UProperty Market! To complete it, all you need to do is confirm your email address.

This confirmation validates your sign-up and lets us keep your details so we can send you news and let you know about the platform's official launch.
